name: pincode-input
title: PIN Code Input
description: Indian PIN field that reads the state from the first digits offline and flags a mismatch with the picked state, catches O typed for 0, wrong lengths, unused prefixes, Army Post codes and ZIP or UK postcodes typed for India, then checks the area and city through your lookup.

meta.stops: Parcel sent to the wrong state
meta.summary: Reads the state from an Indian PIN's first digits as you type and flags a mismatch with the chosen state, so a parcel doesn't go to the wrong place.
catches: PIN prefix that doesn't match the chosen state
Letter O for 0, and digits from other scripts
US ZIP or UK postcodes typed for India, with a country switch
limits: Prefix-to-state is a table and can't tell every border case without the lookup
Format looks valid is not the same as deliverable
Area and city checks need your lookup
a11y: Visible label; input has aria-invalid when the lookup finds nothing and is described by a polite status
Fixes are buttons; focus returns to the input

rules.note: Not verified this round: the prefix-to-state table is from India Post via Wikipedia ("Postal Index Number"), not a primary India Post source.
